name: THR Insurance Agency
description: THR Insurance Agency in Telford, PA is the easy, trusted way to buy insurance: business insurance, home and auto insurance, and human resources support, serving Telford and Lansdale.
tagline: The easy, trusted way to buy insurance

hero.headline: The easy, trusted way to buy insurance
hero.sub: Business, home, and auto coverage placed with featured insurance partners, plus human resources support most agencies do not offer.

offerings.heading: Three things THR <mark>does well.</mark>
items: Business insurance quoted across several carriers
Home and auto insurance bundled and reviewed at renewal
Human resources support and a client portal for documents
Independent agency with featured insurance partners

story.heading: Why an independent agency
paragraphs: THR Insurance Agency sits on Ridge Road in Telford and shops a sample of featured insurance partners for you, then explains the difference in plain language.
The human resources side grew from business clients asking the same questions about hiring and compliance.

experience.heading: Getting covered
items: Request a quote online or call; THR shops it across carriers.
Choose coverage with an agent who explains what changes.
Manage documents through the client portal after you bind.

feature.heading: Business insurance and HR, together
feature.text: One agency for general liability, commercial auto, workers' comp, and the human resources questions that come with a payroll.

closing.heading: The easy, trusted way to buy insurance
